title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：obstacle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 obstacle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the athlete ① cleared the obstacle that no trainer in the stadium would have counted, and he said the clearing was the whole of the year. The ② obstacle, meaning the block itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; an obstacle, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ obstacle in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ obstacle at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An obstacle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the athlete said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the obstacle was the whole of the matter, meaning the difficulty and not the block. The ⑥ obstacle, meaning the difficulty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; obstacle, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both a block and a difficulty. He said the difficulty is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ obstacle had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ obstacle of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of counting; obstacle, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ obstacle I remember is the block counted in the programme, which closed in 1998 and is still counted as the quietest in the stadium. An ⑩ obstacle, my mother said in 2000, is the only block that improves by being counted; every obstacle, she said, is a difficulty that has agreed to look like a block. She said the difficulty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 障碍；阻碍（指体育场里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 障碍；阻碍（指那道障碍本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the obstacle 排除这一道障碍
D. n. 障碍；阻碍（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 障碍之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的障碍之事）
F. n. 障碍；阻碍（指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一道）
G. n. 障碍、难关（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 难关（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the obstacle that no trainer in the stadium would have counted
The obstacle, meaning the block itself and not the bib
the obstacle at the far track
the obstacle was the whole of the matter
the obstacle had become a line in a programme
The obstacle of the whole thing
An obstacle, my mother said in 2000

answers.why: clear the obstacle 意为“排除这一道障碍”，1991 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯清点的一道障碍做了一遍。
obstacle 意为“障碍；阻碍”，指那道障碍本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
obstacle 意为“障碍；阻碍”，指体育场里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
obstacle 意为“障碍；阻碍”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
obstacle 意为“障碍、难关”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道难关就是那件事的全部。
obstacle 意为“难关”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道障碍，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
obstacle 意为“障碍；阻碍”，指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一道，到 1996 年这一道成了秩序册里的一行。
obstacle 意为“障碍之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的障碍之事是一处体育场和三个年份的清点。
obstacle 意为“障碍；阻碍”，我记得的是秩序册里清点过的那一道，1998 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一道。
obstacle 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，障碍是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的障碍。
